name: NGC 3384-DF11 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3384-DF11, a faint low surface brightness object, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3384df11-hubble
story: A faint, diffuse glow found by the Dragonfly telescope array in the sky around the galaxy NGC 3384. Hubble looked closer to measure its distance, to learn whether it is a companion of the galaxies there or an ultra diffuse galaxy of its own.

claims.text: NGC3384-DF11 is one of 23 newly discovered low surface brightness objects in Dragonfly fields, in the field centered on NGC 3384
The program measures distances to these objects to build satellite luminosity functions and constrain ultra diffuse galaxies outside rich clusters
